# Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

- **Issuing Organization:** National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
- **Official Portal:** https://pmjay.gov.in / https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in
- **National Helpline:** 14555 / 1800-111-565
- **Category:** Health Insurance & Hospitalization Coverage
- **Last Updated:** October 2023

## Scheme Overview
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme. It provides a health cover of up to ₹5,00,000 (Five Lakh Rupees) per eligible family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. The scheme is completely cashless and paperless at all empanelled public and private healthcare providers across India.

## Key Benefits
- **Financial Protection:** Up to ₹5 lakh per family per year on a family floater basis, with no restriction on

oviders across India.

## Key Benefits
- **Financial Protection:** Up to ₹5 lakh per family per year on a family floater basis, with no restriction on family size, age, or gender.
- **Coverage Details:** Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses, including diagnostic tests, room charges, ICU fees, physician consultations, medical implants, surgery, and medications.
- **Pre-existing Conditions:** All pre-existing medical conditions are covered from day one of enrollment without any waiting period.
- **Cashless Treatment:** Beneficiaries do not have to pay any advance deposit or out-of-pocket expenses at empanelled healthcare providers (EHCP).
- **Portability:** Benefits can be availed at any empanelled hospital (public or private) anywhere in India, allowing migrant and gig workers to access healthcare away from their home state.

## Eligibility Criteria
- Identified based on deprivation and occupational criteria from the Socio-Economic Caste Census 2011 (SECC 2011) for rural and urban areas.
- Urban informal workers automatically covered include:
 - Street vendors, hawkers, cobblers, and ragpickers.
 - Domestic workers, cleaners, sanitation workers, and sweepers.
 - Transport workers, drivers, conductors, delivery gig workers, and rickshaw pullers.
 - Construction workers, plumbers, masons, painters, and electricians.
 - Shop workers, tailors, mechanics, repair workers, and artisans.
- Eligible families possessing Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) ration cards under NFSA.

## How Informal & Gig Workers Can Access Benefits
1. **Check Eligibility:** Visit https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in, use the Ayushman App, or call 14555 with your Aadhaar number or Ration card number.
2. **Ayushman Card Generation:** Complete Aadhaar e-KYC at any Common Service Center (CSC), Primary Health Center (PHC), or empanelled hospital through the Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra (PMAM).
3. **Hospital Admission:** Present your Ayushman Card or Aadhaar number at the PM-JAY helpdesk at any empanelled hospital for instant verification and cashless admission.

# Employees' State Insurance Scheme (ESIC) Medical & Sickness Benefits

- **Issuing Organization:** Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
- **Official Portal:** https://www.esic.gov.in
- **Toll-Free Helpline:** 1800-11-2526 / 14470
- **Category:** Social Security, Healthcare & Sickness Cash Benefit
- **Last Updated:** August 2023

## Scheme Overview
The Employees' State Insurance Act provides social security and health protection to workers in organized and transitional sectors against contingencies of sickness, maternity, disablement, and death due to employment injury. Under recent national social security initiatives (Code on Social Security 2020), ESIC benefits are being progressively extended to platform gig workers and gig delivery aggregators.

## Medical Care Benefits
- **Full Medical Care:** Comprehensive

re being progressively extended to platform gig workers and gig delivery aggregators.

## Medical Care Benefits
- **Full Medical Care:** Comprehensive outpatient and inpatient medical care provided to insured workers (IP - Insured Persons) and their dependent family members from day one of insurable employment.
- **Facilities:** Services delivered through dedicated ESI dispensaries, 160+ ESIC Model Hospitals, and tie-up super-specialty hospitals for tertiary treatments (cardiology, oncology, nephrology).
- **No Ceiling on Medical Expenses:** There is no financial cap on the medical care expenses incurred for the treatment of an Insured Person or their family members.

## Cash Benefits for Sickness and Disablement
1. **Sickness Benefit:**
 - 70% of the average daily wage payable during certified medical sickness for up to 91 days in any continuous two consecutive benefit periods.
 -

 - 70% of the average daily wage payable during certified medical sickness for up to 91 days in any continuous two consecutive benefit periods.
 - Requires payment of contributions for not less than 78 days in the corresponding contribution period.
2. **Extended Sickness Benefit:**
 - 80% of daily wage for up to 2 years for 34 specified long-term debilitating diseases (such as tuberculosis, cancer, mental illness, heart diseases).
3. **Temporary Disablement Benefit (TDB):**
 - 90% of daily wage paid continuously from day one of employment injury or occupational accident resulting in temporary disability, until recovery or stabilization.
4. **Permanent Disablement Benefit (PDB):**
 - Monthly pension paid at up to 90% of wage depending on the percentage loss of earning capacity determined by the Medical Board.
5. **Maternity Benefit:**
 - 100% of average daily wage for 26 weeks for

g on the percentage loss of earning capacity determined by the Medical Board.
5. **Maternity Benefit:**
 - 100% of average daily wage for 26 weeks for female insured workers during confinement/childbirth.

## Relevance to Platform & Gig Workers
- Aggregators participating in ESIC pilot initiatives register delivery partners and drivers via their e-Shram UAN (Universal Account Number).
- Once registered, gig workers receive an e-Pehchan card granting access to nearby ESIC dispensaries and emergency accident care without hospital fees.

# Occupational Health, Symptom Triage & Generic Medicines Guide for Gig Workers

- **Issuing Body:** FairWork Setu Occupational Health & Clinical Safety Council
- **References:** National Health Mission (NHM), National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
- **Emergency Helplines:** 108 (Ambulance), 112 (National Emergency), 102 (Maternal/Child Emergency), 14555 (Ayushman PM-JAY), 1800-180-8080 (Jan Aushadhi Helpline)
- **Target Population:** Platform and gig delivery riders, auto/cab drivers, domestic workers, street vendors, and logistics workers across India.

## 1. Respiratory Infections: Cold, Cough, Sore Throat & Nasal Congestion (जुकाम / सर्दी / खांसी / कफ)
- **Synonyms & Dialect Terms:** Jukam, zukaam, zukham, sardi, thandi lag gayi, nazla, khansi, khasi, sukhi khansi, balgam wali khansi, kaf, cough, gala kharab, gale me

alect Terms:** Jukam, zukaam, zukham, sardi, thandi lag gayi, nazla, khansi, khasi, sukhi khansi, balgam wali khansi, kaf, cough, gala kharab, gale me dard, gale me kharash, chheenk, naak behna, naak band, saans lene me sarsarhat, sinus, thand lag gayi, bike chalane se sardi.
- **Immediate Shift First-Aid & Self-Care:**
 1. **Warm Hydration:** Sip lukewarm water or herbal/ginger-tulsi tea during work shifts. Keep a thermos of warm water on your bike. Avoid cold sodas, chilled water, or abrupt shifts between AC restaurants and scorching outdoor roads.
 2. **Steam Inhalation:** Inhale steam from plain boiling water for 10 minutes at night and after finishing shifts to loosen nasal and bronchial mucus.
 3. **Warm Salt-Water Gargle:** Gargle with 1 glass warm water mixed with half teaspoon salt twice daily to relieve throat soreness and reduce viral inflammation.

## 2. Dehydration, Heat Stress & Sunstroke (निर्जलीकरण / लू / डिहाइड्रेशन / अत्यधिक प्यास)
- **Synonyms & Dialect Terms:** Dehydration, dihydration, lu lagna, loo lag gayi, dhup lag gayi, dhoop me chakkar, garmi chadh gayi, pyaas, gala sookh raha hai, hoth sookh rahe hain, paseena nahi aa raha, bahut paseena beh gaya, sar ghoom raha hai, kamzori lag rahi hai, behoshi jaisa lag raha hai, chakkar aana, exhaustion, heat stress, heat cramps.
- **Immediate Shift Protocol:**
 1. **Stop & Park in Shade:** Pull over your bike or vehicle immediately into shade. Turn off ignition.
 2. **Cool Down:** Remove helmet, jacket, and tight delivery backpacks/vests. Sponge forehead, nape of the neck, and wrists with a cool damp cloth.
 3. **Hydrate Slowly:** Sip Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) solution slowly. Drink 1 glass over 10-15

ape of the neck, and wrists with a cool damp cloth.
 3. **Hydrate Slowly:** Sip Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) solution slowly. Drink 1 glass over 10-15 minutes.
 - **Warning:** Do NOT gulp down ice-chilled water or refrigerator drinks rapidly; sudden temperature shock triggers severe stomach cramps, vomiting, and vascular constriction.
- **Subsidized Jan Aushadhi (PMBJP) Electrolytes:**
 - *Jan Aushadhi WHO-formula ORS Sachet (21.8g):* ₹4 to ₹5 per sachet (versus ₹22 to ₹30 for commercial branded Electral).
 - Fresh coconut water, thin buttermilk (chaas) with rock salt, or lemon-water with sugar and a pinch of salt serve as natural alternatives.
- **🚨 Critical Red-Flag Emergency (Heat Stroke - Call 108):**
 - High core body temperature (>103°F) accompanied by the *complete absence of sweating* (hot dry skin).
 - Mental confusion, slurred speech, delirium, disorientation, loss of

ture (>103°F) accompanied by the *complete absence of sweating* (hot dry skin).
 - Mental confusion, slurred speech, delirium, disorientation, loss of consciousness, or repeated severe vomiting.
 - Call 108 immediately and pour room-temperature water continuously over the worker's head and chest until the ambulance arrives.

## 3. Fever, Viral Infection & Body Ache (बुखार / बदन दर्द / वायरल / हरारत)
- **Synonyms & Dialect Terms:** Bukhar, bukhaar, buhar, fever, hararat, tap, taap, shareer garam hai, badan dard, badan toot raha hai, ang ang toot raha hai, sir dard, sar phat raha hai, thakan, susti, kapkapi, thand lagkar bukhar, viral, dengue jaisa lag raha, malaria, chills.
- **Immediate First-Aid & Rest Protocol:**
 1. **Strict Rest:** Stop strenuous outdoor riding; physical exertion during fever increases myocardial strain and accelerates dehydration.
 2. **Tepid Sponging:**

Rest:** Stop strenuous outdoor riding; physical exertion during fever increases myocardial strain and accelerates dehydration.
 2. **Tepid Sponging:** Sponge forehead, arms, and legs with normal room-temperature water. Do NOT use ice water.
 3. **Fluids:** Drink at least 2.5 to 3 liters of fluids daily (lukewarm water, thin dal, ORS, vegetable soup).
- **Subsidized Jan Aushadhi (PMBJP) Guidance:**
 - *Generic Paracetamol 500mg:* 1 tablet every 6 to 8 hours after food (maximum 2,000mg/day for gig workers without liver disease). Strip of 10 costs ₹5 to ₹10.
 - **CRITICAL CLINICAL SAFETY WARNING:** Do NOT consume Aspirin, Ibuprofen, Combiflam, or unprescribed NSAIDs without medical examination. If the fever is Dengue, these drugs cause platelet inhibition and life-threatening internal gastrointestinal hemorrhage!

 - Fever accompanied by severe

- **⚠️ UPHC Referral Indicators:**
 - Fever accompanied by severe retro-orbital eye pain, joint/bone pain, red petechial skin rashes (Dengue warning).
 - Chills with teeth-chattering rigors recurring every alternate day (Malaria warning).

## 4. Digestive Upset, Acidity, Gastritis & Food Poisoning (पेट दर्द / गैस / एसिडिटी / उल्टी-दस्त)

- **Immediate First-Aid & Dietary Steps:**
 1. **Prevent Dehydration:** Consume 1 cup of fresh ORS solution after every loose motion or vomit episode.
 2. **Bland BRAT Diet:** Eat freshly prepared curd rice, plain moong dal khichdi, bananas, and toast. Avoid roadside cutting chai, fried samosas, spicy curries, and unwashed raw street salads.
 3. **Rest the Gut:** Avoid carbonated beverages and sugary energy drinks which worsen osmotic diarrhea.

 - *Jan Aushadhi ORS Sachet:* ₹4 to ₹5 per sachet.

per sachet.

 - *Antacid Oral Suspension (200ml):* ₹25 to ₹35 at Jan Aushadhi stores (relieves acute heartburn).
 - *Dicyclomine 10mg / Mefenamic:* ₹8 to ₹12 per strip under pharmacist guidance for acute abdominal spasms.

 - Bloody or black tarry stools.
 - Inability to keep any liquid down for more than 6 hours with severe dry tongue and sunken eyes.
 - High fever (>102°F) with intense localized lower-right abdominal pain (acute appendicitis red-flag).

## 5. Musculoskeletal Strain, Backache & Rider Ergonomics (कमर दर्द / गर्दन का खिंचाव / जोड़ दर्द)

ache & Rider Ergonomics (कमर दर्द / गर्दन का खिंचाव / जोड़ दर्द)
- **Synonyms & Dialect Terms:** Kamar dard, back pain, peeth dard, gardan akdna, neck stiffness, kandha dard, shoulder pain, ghutna dard, haath pair dard, nerves khinch gayi, bike chalane se kamar dard, delivery bag uthane se dard, moch aa gayi, muscle cramp, nas chad gayi.
- **Rider Ergonomics & Shift Protocols:**
 1. **Mount Bag on Cargo Rack:** Never carry heavy 10-15 kg delivery backpacks exclusively on your shoulders for 10-hour shifts. Fasten the backpack to the bike rear carrier using sturdy bungee cords.
 2. **Active Decompression Breaks:** Take a 3-5 minute posture break every 2 hours: roll shoulders backwards, do gentle neck stretches, and arch the lower back while standing.
 3. **Adjust Handlebars & Seat:** Ensure bike handles allow elbows to stay slightly bent; locked rigid elbows transfer road shock directly

e standing.
 3. **Adjust Handlebars & Seat:** Ensure bike handles allow elbows to stay slightly bent; locked rigid elbows transfer road shock directly into cervical vertebrae.
- **At-Home Relief & Jan Aushadhi Remedies:**
 - Apply warm compress (hot water bottle) for 15-20 minutes on the lower back or neck after returning home.
 - *Jan Aushadhi Diclofenac Gel / Pain Spray (30g):* ₹20 to ₹25 (versus ₹120 to ₹160 for commercial branded spray like Volini).
 - *Generic Paracetamol 500mg:* ₹5 to ₹10 for acute muscular aching. Avoid long-term self-medication with strong painkiller pills to protect renal health.

## 6. Minor Wounds, Burns & Silencer Injuries (मामूली चोट / खरोंच / साइलेंसर बर्न)
- **Synonyms & Dialect Terms:** Chot lag gayi, khronch, cut lag gaya, silencer se jal gaya, bike silencer burn, chhil gaya, ungli kat gayi, halka khoon aaya, minor injury, burn dressing, road

gayi, khronch, cut lag gaya, silencer se jal gaya, bike silencer burn, chhil gaya, ungli kat gayi, halka khoon aaya, minor injury, burn dressing, road scrape.
- **Bike Exhaust Silencer Burn Protocol:**
 1. **Immediate Cooling:** Hold the affected burned skin under gentle, clean, room-temperature running tap water for 10 to 15 minutes continuously.
 2. **Do NOT:** Never apply toothpaste, ice cubes, engine oil, butter, or raw turmeric onto fresh burns—these trap heat inside tissues and cause severe microbial infections.
 3. **Do NOT Pop Blisters:** Intact skin blisters (fafola) serve as sterile biological band-aids protecting underlying dermis.
 4. **Antiseptic Burn Ointment:** Gently apply *Silver Sulfadiazine 1% cream* (Jan Aushadhi: ₹15 to ₹20 per 20g tube; commercial brands: ₹80 to ₹120) and cover loosely with sterile paraffin gauze.

- **Road Scrapes & Abrasions:**
 - Wash road dust and grit gently with soap and clean tap water.

## 8. Critical Emergency Red-Flag Protocol (Direct Bypass - Immediate 108 / 112)
- **Life-Threatening Emergency Warning Signs:**
 1. Crushing chest pain, severe tightness radiating to the left arm, neck, or jaw, accompanied by profuse cold sweat (acute myocardial infarction / heart attack).
 2. Severe shortness of breath, gasping for air, blue-tinted lips, or choking.
 3. Sudden loss of consciousness, fainting, or unresponsive collapse.
 4. Sudden facial droop, arm weakness, inability to speak or slurred speech (acute stroke warning).
 5. Uncontrolled arterial spurting or

ve collapse.
 4. Sudden facial droop, arm weakness, inability to speak or slurred speech (acute stroke warning).
 5. Uncontrolled arterial spurting or severe continuous bleeding following a road accident.
 6. Suspected poison ingestion, chemical splash, or snakebite.
- **Immediate Response Actions:**
 - **Dial 108:** Free 24x7 Government Emergency Ambulance with basic or advanced life support.
 - **Dial 112:** All-India Unified Emergency helpline for police, fire, and trauma coordination.
 - **Dial 102:** Free dedicated transport for pregnant women and neonates.
 - Proceed immediately to the nearest 24x7 Government Medical College, District Civil Hospital, or trauma casualty.

# Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) Pension Scheme

- **Issuing Organization:** Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
- **Implementing Agency:** Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) & Common Service Centres (CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd.)
- **Official Portal:** https://maandhan.in
- **National Helpdesk:** 1800-267-6888
- **Category:** Old-Age Pension & Social Security for Unorganised Workers
- **Launched:** February 2019

## Scheme Overview
PM-SYM is a central government-sponsored voluntary and contributory pension scheme meant for ensuring old-age income security to unorganised and informal workers, including gig delivery workers, domestic workers, street vendors, rickshaw drivers, construction workers, and agricultural labourers.

## Key Financial Benefits
- **Assured Monthly Pension:** ₹3,000 per month guaranteed lifelong pension once the

n workers, and agricultural labourers.

## Key Financial Benefits
- **Assured Monthly Pension:** ₹3,000 per month guaranteed lifelong pension once the beneficiary completes 60 years of age.
- **Family Pension on Death:** If the subscriber dies during the receipt of the pension, their spouse is entitled to receive 50% of the pension (₹1,500/month) as family pension.
- **Government Matching Contribution:** The scheme operates on a 50:50 basis. For every rupee deposited by the worker into their pension account (₹55 to ₹200 per month depending on age of entry), the Central Government deposits an equal matching amount.

## Eligibility Criteria
- Must be an unorganised or informal worker (such as auto driver, courier/delivery rider, tailor, street hawker, domestic helper).
- Entry age: Between 18 and 40 years strictly. Workers aged 41 or above (e.g., 44 years) are not eligible to enroll in

treet hawker, domestic helper).
- Entry age: Between 18 and 40 years strictly. Workers aged 41 or above (e.g., 44 years) are not eligible to enroll in PM-SYM. For individuals aged above 40, alternative government schemes such as Atal Pension Yojana (APY, enrollable up to age 40) or National Pension System (NPS-All Citizen model, enrollable up to age 70) and voluntary savings through post office schemes are recommended.
- Monthly income: ₹15,000 per month or below.
- Must not be covered under other formal statutory schemes:
 - Not an existing member of EPFO, NPS, or ESIC.
 - Not an income tax assessee.
- Required documents: Aadhaar card and Savings Bank / Jan Dhan account with auto-debit facility.

## Contribution Table by Age
- Age 18: ₹55/month worker share + ₹55/month government share = ₹110 total
- Age 25: ₹80/month worker share + ₹80/month government share = ₹160 total
- Age 30:

₹55/month worker share + ₹55/month government share = ₹110 total
- Age 25: ₹80/month worker share + ₹80/month government share = ₹160 total
- Age 30: ₹105/month worker share + ₹105/month government share = ₹210 total
- Age 35: ₹150/month worker share + ₹150/month government share = ₹300 total
- Age 40: ₹200/month worker share + ₹200/month government share = ₹400 total

## How to Enroll
1. Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or visit https://maandhan.in for self-enrollment.
2. Provide Aadhaar Card and Savings/Jan Dhan Bank details (IFSC code and account number).
3. The initial contribution amount is paid in cash at the CSC center, and subsequent monthly installments are auto-debited from the bank account.
4. An instant Shram Yogi Pension Card with a unique Shram Yogi Pension Account Number is generated.

# Rajasthan Platform Based Gig Workers (Registration and Welfare) Act, 2023

- **Issuing Organization:** Department of Labour, Government of Rajasthan
- **Official Status:** State Legislative Act (Act No. 17 of 2023)
- **Official Portal:** https://labour.rajasthan.gov.in
- **Category:** Gig Worker Social Security & Emergency Assistance
- **Enacted:** July 2023

## Act Overview
The Rajasthan Platform Based Gig Workers (Registration and Welfare) Act, 2023 is India's first landmark legislation designed specifically to protect the legal rights, social security, occupational health, and welfare of app-based gig workers (delivery partners, rideshare drivers, home service workers, and quick-commerce agents).

## The Gig Workers Welfare Board & Fund
- **Rajasthan Platform Based Gig Workers Welfare Board:**
 - Tripartite board comprising government officials, representatives of gig worker

rd & Fund
- **Rajasthan Platform Based Gig Workers Welfare Board:**
 - Tripartite board comprising government officials, representatives of gig worker unions/associations, and platform aggregator representatives (e.g., Zomato, Swiggy, Uber, Ola, Urban Company, Zepto, Blinkit).
- **The Social Security and Welfare Fund:**

## Worker Registration Process
1. Aggregators must automatically onboard all onboarded gig workers operating within Rajasthan into the state portal within 60 days.
2. Gig workers can independently verify or update their profile using their Aadhaar and mobile number on the Rajasthan Labour portal.
3. Access to welfare fund grants and emergency medical reimbursement is initiated via the worker's unique ID.
